# Data Integrity Checklist: GitHub Pilot Issue Ingest and Eligibility

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009C1 requirements and plan artifacts fully define GitHub issue identity, workspace-scoped task uniqueness, idempotent duplicate prevention, local-only exclusion, and current-schema side-effect absence.
**Created**: 2026-05-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are pilot issue identity requirements complete for repository, issue number, open issue-not-PR state, required labels, linked PR absence, terminal-status exclusion, and duplicate synced task absence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Pilot GitHub Issue]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the exactly-one pilot root task proof keyed by workspace, GitHub repository, GitHub issue number, synced timestamp, and root-task shape so one issue maps to one task within the Mission Control workspace? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Sync Identity Proof, Data Model §Pilot Root Task]
- [ ] CHK003 Are duplicate-prevention requirements complete for both pre-admission rejection of already-synced issues and post-sync idempotency after repeated ingest/sync? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-002, Research §Duplicate Prevention]
- [ ] CHK004 Are local-only task exclusion requirements complete enough to preserve non-pilot local tasks while preventing them from satisfying pilot eligibility or source-of-truth evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are current-schema side-effect absence requirements complete across child tasks, task-chain lineage, dispatch attempts, assignment, runs, task dispositions, task artifacts, activities, and guarded future-table checks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Side-Effect Snapshot]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the difference between the live GitHub search prefilter and fixture-compatible local eligibility filters clear enough to avoid relying on live GitHub search semantics for automated tests? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 1, Spec §FR-002, Research §Eligibility]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "exactly one routable area label" defined through lowercased/deduped `area:*` parsing and `single_match` resolution against current `projects.area_slug` values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Eligibility Decision]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "duplicate synced task" defined with objective GitHub linkage and sync evidence rather than mutable issue title or local task id? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-008, Research §Duplicate Prevention]
- [ ] CHK009 Is local-only task exclusion phrased as a positive pilot source-of-truth invariant rather than an implication of missing GitHub fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK010 Are future claim, runner, and sandbox table checks clearly limited to table-if-exists guards so SPEC-009C1 does not require placeholder schema? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Side-Effect Snapshot]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can exactly-one pilot root task creation be objectively measured with a SQL count that includes workspace, repository, issue number, sync timestamp, and root-task predicate? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Contract §Sync Identity Proof]
- [ ] CHK016 Can idempotent duplicate sync be measured by rerunning ingest/sync and asserting the pilot root task count remains one for the same workspace/repository/issue identity? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002, Quickstart §Manual Live Smoke Path]
- [ ] CHK017 Can ineligible candidate rejection be measured with stable reason coverage for missing labels, ambiguous area routing, linked PR, terminal state, duplicate synced task, and wrong repository? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003, Quickstart §Fixture Expectations]
- [ ] CHK018 Can local-only exclusion be objectively measured without requiring a GitHub token or live GitHub mutation? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Quickstart §Fixture Expectations]
- [ ] CHK019 Can current-schema side-effect absence be measured without depending on future claim, runner, sandbox, or run-state tables? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Contract §Side-Effect Snapshot]
